versions.changelog: User-invocable slash commands (status/log/recover/distill/prune/stop/delete); hand goals to OpenClaw's /goal tool; recovery uses session_status changesSince with sessions_search fallback; distillation targets USER.md directives; notes on session state awareness and personal users/<profile>/USER.md; version notes for mixed OpenClaw releases.

Declare shared memory write paths; distillation into shared memory now requires user approval in the same conversation (proposal only when unattended); only the current conversation's file is distilled.
Session files keyed by OpenClaw session key with exact identity check before read/write; fixes cross-channel slug collisions; legacy files are owner-migrated.
Remove shared working buffer (cross-channel leak); add user notice/stop/delete controls; recovery via sessions_search/sessions_history; MIT-0.
Address ClawHub security review: clarify cron/scheduler scope, align with hierarchical-agent-memory v3 security notes
v2.1: Judgment-based WAL triggers, topic file distillation targets, active topic references in session state, hierarchical-agent-memory v3 integration
Fix broken GitHub links, replace colon-in-filename example with filesystem-safe slugs, remove emoji from WAL trigger list, clean up duplicate integration bullet
v2.0.0: Enhanced with Write-Ahead Log (WAL) protocol, working buffer management, and cleaned all personal/sensitive information. Improved documentation for per-channel session isolation.
Repositioned description: leads with per-channel session isolation as the core value, WAL and compaction recovery as complementary
Initial release: per-channel session isolation, WAL protocol, working buffer, compaction recovery
